integrity: Derived analytically from disjoint edge families conditional on initial color classes, with exact finite graph/color enumeration and seeded independent graph simulations; finite checks support but do not prove the infinite-size limit.
scientific_limitations: Annealed random-graph and product-color law; fixed strictly positive color masses; only the all-rotating time-zero primitive-three event. No quenched result, basin census, other-period census, or claimed full literature priority. In disconnected graphs immediate primitive-three configurations need not rotate every component.
title: A rarest-color Poisson threshold for immediate three-cycles in random excitable networks
